reasoning_content: The build succeeded! Now let's start the server with PM2.

action.command:
cd /workspace/project && python3 << 'PYEOF'
import paramiko
client = paramiko.SSHClient()
client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
client.connect("46.202.154.25", 22, "root", "2N00py123+++")

print("=== Starting Server with PM2 ===")

# Delete old processes and start fresh
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("pm2 delete all && pm2 start /opt/areloria/ecosystem.config.cjs && sleep 5 && pm2 list")
print(stdout.read().decode())

# Check health
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' http://localhost:3000/health")
print("\nHealth check:", stdout.read().decode())

# Check logs
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("pm2 logs areloria --lines 15 --nostream")
print("\n=== Recent Logs ===")
print(stdout.read().decode()[-1500:])

client.close()
PYEOF
